A little about me

I’m a physician in Taipei who enjoys coding, making sense of data, and working with people from different fields. My research began with neuroscience and synthetic biology during medical school. These days, I’m especially interested in how wearable devices can help us understand work, fatigue, and recovery.

Beyond the hospital

Outside medicine, I like films, novels, live music, and being in the water. I’m usually happy to try a new activity—or hear someone’s story.
